subject.title: [Bug]: Empty assistant delivery (footer-only, "— out" usage) on first turn after /new on Telegram-routed topic lane — 2026.5.27

question: Should this umbrella be narrowed to the durable reset/phantom-binding invariant first, or should maintainers keep it as a broader Telegram delivery/recovery UX tracker?
rationale: Current source proves a concrete reset durability gap, but several other asks are schema, channel UX, or documentation decisions that need maintainer ownership before one fix lane can safely proceed.

options.title: Prioritize reset durability
options.body: Treat durable reset binding and missing-transcript self-heal as the canonical remaining fix, then split the fallback/progress/usage/docs asks into separate issues if still needed.

options.title: Keep the umbrella open
options.body: Use this issue as a maintainer-sponsored tracker for the whole Telegram reset and delivery-mirror family, accepting that implementation will need multiple PRs and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Close after splitting
options.body: Close this issue only after creating or confirming narrower canonical issues for every remaining behavior that maintainers still want to own.

recommendation.title: Prioritize reset durability
recommendation.body: Treat durable reset binding and missing-transcript self-heal as the canonical remaining fix, then split the fallback/progress/usage/docs asks into separate issues if still needed.

likelyOwner.reason: The most concrete remaining source gap is in the session lifecycle/storage seam that Josh Lehman recently refactored and now likely understands best.
